node.label: Elevated circulating globotriaosylceramide concentration
node.definition: Increased concentration of globotriaosylceramide (Gb3) in the blood circulation. Globotriaosylceramide, also named ceramidetrihexoside, is the primary lipid storage in Fabry disease.
